Filters

Letters are not picked by experts or pro players. A formula sets them from a sample of ranked battles, where win rate weighs 90% and use rate 10%, so a rarely picked brawler who wins often can rank high. The win rate shown covers all battles, while the letter weighs each map by the square of the brawler's pick share there. So the letter reflects strength on the maps where the brawler is actually played, and a one map specialist can rank higher than the overall win rate suggests. The number with ≈ under the win rate is the win rate adjusted for the number of picks: for a rarely picked brawler it is pulled toward the average, and the tier is based on it. How this tier list works

The list is calculated from 232 710 ranked battles. Every brawler gets a score from 0 to 10, where win rate counts for 90% and use rate for 10%, and the maps a brawler is played on most weigh more. Showdown and some modes are not in Ranked, their numbers come from 593 021 trophy battles.

Right now Mr. P leads the ranked meta with a 58.6% win rate and a 2.7% use rate.

The highest win rate belongs to Mr. P with 58.6%, currently in tier S+.

What the tiers mean

S+
The very top of the meta. These brawlers have the highest score by win rate and pick rate on the maps where they are played.
S
The strongest picks of the current meta, by win rate and pick rate on the maps where they are played.
A
Great brawlers that win reliably, slightly behind the top of the meta.
B
Solid picks that shine on the right maps.
C
Average brawlers. Playable, but other picks usually do the same job better.
D
Weak in the current meta. Worth it only on maps that suit them.

Frequently asked questions

What are the best brawlers in Brawl Stars right now?
According to current ranked data, the ten strongest brawlers are Mr. P, Hank, Bibi, Juju, Bo, Angelo, Ash, Bolt, Amber, Chuck.
How are the tier letters calculated?
The letters come from statistics, not from expert or pro opinion. Every brawler gets a score from 0 to 10 based on ranked battles of the last 30 days, where win rate weighs 90% and use rate 10%, and the letter follows from the score. The sample has 232 710 ranked battles.
Which brawlers are picked most often?
The ten most picked brawlers in ranked right now are Brock, Rico, Amber, Squeak, Chester, Gus, Piper, Mr. P, Griff, Mandy.
What is the best brawler trio in Brawl Stars?
In Knockout, the most played ranked mode, the best trio is Brock, Mr. P, Pearl. It wins 79.3% of its battles, while the strength of the three brawlers on their own predicts 61.1%.
Which brawler has the highest win rate right now?
Mr. P has the highest ranked win rate right now at 58.6% and is in tier S+.
Where can I see stats for one brawler?
Click the brawler on the tier list or find them under All brawlers on this page. Their card shows tier and score, win rate and use rate, best modes and maps, teammates and counters, Star Powers, Gadgets and the tier for each day.
What do good and amazing maps mean?
A map is good for a brawler when their win rate there is above the map average and they are picked noticeably often. An amazing map means the win rate is well above average.
How often does the tier list change?
The list is rebuilt from new ranked battles, and the date at the top of the page shows the latest update. Top brawlers can shift weekly after balance changes and map rotations.
